chunks: And Kulayb al-Asadī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

That the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله sought permission from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, regarding Mecca three times over the course of time, and Allah granted him permission in it for one hour of the day; then He made it sacred for as long as the heavens and the earth endure.

key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, the Prophet Muhammad
key_terms.سَاعَةً: a single hour, indicating limited duration

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the sacred status of Mecca and the limited permission granted to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was granted a limited permission regarding Mecca for only one hour of the day. It emphasizes the enduring sacredness and inviolability of Mecca as a sanctified precinct established by Allah.
